Wrote a piece for @vervemagazine about taking the #MeToo movement offline.

https://t.co/F1gwbjQoSP

Everyone asking me- went solo tripping across UK, almost got married (but didn't), adopted two v cute kitties, joined a gym, worked for #MeToo survivors, learned contouring, bettered my mental health, realized I'm actually a badass, met amazing women and embraced my dark circles!
Will be on air today on NDTV 24x7 at 8.30pm to talk about the Genpact case. Do watch! #MeToo

My two cents- we need to learn from this incident as to how corporates can handle complaints better. The public backlash against the complainants is unfair. Again, this a very rare case and should not be used to deter complainants or derail the #MeToo movement.

Mid-day did a special piece called "Year of the Woman" and women who made an impact in 2018, and named me one of them. So thrilled to close this year on such a high! Here's to more hard work, more sleepless nights and more challenges in 2019! 💪🏻 #MeToo #TimesUp https://t.co/TvFkfh6MF2

Shout-out to @AnooBhu who's been featured in today's Mid-day, talking about the impact of #MeToo in Indian media and how she, along with @MasalaBai and @TheRestlessQuil are building a support system for women journalists. So proud to know these women! ❤️ https://t.co/YRDkYNY5Mt

This just breaks by heart. To know someone is helpless and to use that helplessness to your advantage, making a woman feel powerless while sexually harassing her is the lowest of lows. More power to the survivor #MeToo exerpt from @HuffPostIndia https://t.co/SJduEGtoI5

No, @sonamakapoor , your movie is not as important as the #MeToo movement. You, as a cis hetero women, are only cashing on the struggles of the LGBTQI+ community who have done the actual groundwork. Stop gaslighting survivors for your two minutes of fame.
